about: Field of view per actor kind for Timeline mode (CONTRACT.md 'Timeline mode'). radiusM = W / (pmax x sqrt(pi)), so a Gaussian detection profile pmax x exp(-(d/r)^2) integrates to the published effective sweep width W in open terrain. forestRadius x forestPmax = W_forest / W_open. Research, sources and per-terrain W: fov-research.json and docs/rescue-locator/pole-widzenia.md. Owner: AI Michala.

notes.pieszy: W open 80 m, meadow 60, forest 35 (Koester). Night with headlamp x0.34.
notes.pies: Scent W 95 m open, 80 forest. Upwind cone half-angle 25 deg, range up to 150 m at 2-5 m/s wind (2.4 x radius); calm wind = circle 40 m.
notes.dron: Thermal 640x512 at 80 m AGL: footprint 74 x 59 m, W 60 m open, 12 m under canopy. Thermal works at night (no dark penalty).
notes.smiglowiec: W 300 m open from 150 m AGL, 30 m over forest. Night without NVG drops sharply (x0.5 assumed with searchlight).
notes.lodz: W 300 m on water in calm conditions; waves 15-25 kt x0.5, >25 kt x0.25 (not modelled here). Night with searchlight x0.3.
notes.nurek: Underwater W = min(2 x visibility, 6 m); typical lowland lake visibility 2 m, so W about 3 m.
